                            CHAPTER NINETEEN



                         ANSWER KEY


Rather than adding hundreds of extra pages to this workbook by including
the entire answer key – I opted to make you a free downloadable copy.

Just visit www.splitsuit.pro/preflop

I have done my best to double and triple check the answers to this workbook,
but in the event any mistakes have been made, I will email you with an
updated copy. So be sure to use your best email address when downloading
the answer key.

As for using the key, you can print it out. You can use it in side-by-side windows
on your computer. You can open the key on your phone or tablet and double-
check your answers after completing a section of the paperback version of
this book. Whatever works best for you.

My only suggestion would be to check your answers after each section to
correct erroneous calculations before continuing on. An incorrect answer
means there is a mistake in a simple calculation or overall methodology, and
those errors need to be corrected right away.

## PDF page 247

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=247)

```text
                            CHAPTER TWENTY



                   MAJOR TAKEAWAYS


Even though thousands of players will buy this workbook, it is optimistic to
assume that even a few hundred people will get to this chapter. So if you
are reading this after completing every chapter and calculation, I owe you a
high-five if we ever meet each other!

In case you have any doubt about the value of the work you just completed, I
wanted to make sure you see how these elements factor into making actual
decisions at the poker table. Concepts that were covered in this workbook
are in all-caps.

Facing Aggression
As you face bets and raises, you are now more capable of figuring out the
POT ODDS. If you are getting incorrect pot odds, you can figure out the IMPLIED
ODDS and how much extra you need to make on future streets to justify the
original call.

You are more capable of figuring out if your hole cards or the board cards
are BLOCKERS of any strong COMBINATIONS that your opponent could have.
You can also figure out, if you raised them back, what the AUTO-PROFIT point
is given your sizing. Nobody said you have to fold just because you have a
weak hand and unfavorable odds!


                                  PA G E 2 4 7
```

## PDF page 248

[Open source PDF](../../../../sources/pdf/GTO/Poker-Math-Preflop-Workbook.pdf#page=248)

```text
                    P O K E R M AT H & P R E F L O P WO R K B O O K



Being Aggressive
You are more capable when it comes to calculating the BREAKEVEN PER-
CENTAGE of your bet or raise. You know the AUTO-PROFIT point of your size
and can eyeball the EXPECTED VALUE of a single bet or raise.

Preflop you are equipped to 3BET, SQUEEZE, and 4BET more often while identi-
fying how your hole cards can reduce COMBINATIONS of the hands they would
never fold. You know you can add more bluffs into your preflop aggression
ranges as your opponents fold more often and how to estimate the FOLDING
FREQUENCY of multiple players.

If preflop wars break out, you know how to estimate your EQUITY and solve
for PREFLOP ALL-INS, both when calling and shoving yourself. If stacks do not
go ALL-IN PREFLOP, you have the ability to find AUTO-PROFIT cbets and barrels
postflop.

Hand Reading
You are able to sync together PERCENTAGE-FORM and actual RANGES to make
better estimations of their preflop holdings. You can estimate the raw number
of COMBOS within their preflop range simply based upon their FREQUENCIES.

You have also put together that preflop 2bet ranges (OPEN-RAISES & ISOLA-
TIONS) tend to include monster COMBOS (like AA, KK, AK, etc.) while ranges
that call 2bets tend not to. The same concept applies when players 3BET vs.
call a 3bet.




If you only retained 10% of the value from doing these exercises, this workbook
easily pays for itself. But hopefully, through these focused repetitions, you
walk away retaining much more than just 10%.

                                     PA G E 2 4 8
```
